payload.title: Spaces: a profile, many spaces, many projects per space

payload.text: A test caught a visibility leak: refresh() re-listed spaces from disk, so a scoped agent silently widened to every space on its next call. Scoped hubs are fixed now and never widen.

payload.reason: Shipped. The space field and spaceRoot() indirection reserved in the original data model meant this was a restructure, not a migration.
